answer: Hold the payout in escrow until finality. Slash it if the audit fails. Require the grading quorum to span unrelated subnetworks, so five votes from one /24 do not count. A farm then needs real work plus diverse hosting, and a failed audit zeroes the escrow, not just the bonus. Cost is 1 bond per alias plus 3 providers. The tide of cheap single-subnet aliases stops at the door, and the plume of honest work stays visible across an ocean of cloned voters.
